title: Non-ASCII title/author is corrupted on create and returned mangled on read
evidence: src/books_json.erl:5 decodes via binary_to_list (UTF-8 bytes treated as Latin-1 codepoints), :24 unicode:characters_to_binary re-encodes them; src/books_store.erl:134 sql_string(binary_to_list) is encoded again by open_port args (:97). Second-opinion probe on a temp copy: POST author "García" -> sqlite hex 47617263C383C283C382C2AD61 (expected 47617263C3AD61); response author = 37 bytes <<71,97,114,99,195,131,194,131,...>> vs expected <<71,97,114,99,195,173,97>>
suggestion: Decode JSON over UTF-8 (unicode:characters_to_list(Data)) and pass SQL as unicode chars, or use a real JSON lib (jsx/thoas, OTP 27 json) and an SQLite NIF (esqlite) with bound parameters

title: SQLite accessed by spawning the sqlite3 CLI per query with string-built SQL
evidence: src/books_store.erl:90-99 open_port sqlite3 per call; :138 manual quote escaping instead of bound parameters
suggestion: Use esqlite/sqlite NIF with prepared statements

title: Tests cover only ASCII data, so the encoding bug passed
suggestion: Add a round-trip test with a non-ASCII author
